scientific_question: At a deliberately relaxed 22-44x MLP-state compression, can independent per-layer paired Kronecker sums reproduce the dense teacher's MLP functions, or does the required feature/write field still exceed this nonlinear compact family?

causal_basis.finding: Both sides of the shared pair are nonportable, with a -3.4708 CE compensatory interaction. The next family must own independent paired c_fc/c_proj content for every layer rather than transport one shared core.

negative_controls.paired_monarch: 32.43x MLP compression but +0.4465 CE at 0.5TPP; a compact transport around BlockFHT did not supply private content.
negative_controls.shared_core_tri_monarch: 8.67x MLP compression but +0.2398 CE at 0.5TPP; private input/hidden/output transports around one shared dense core regressed the untransported shared core.
negative_controls.sparse_cproj_rank2_kronecker: At 271x, held-out routed-write recovery was only about 0.334.
negative_controls.sparse_cproj_rank9_mpo: At 281x, held-out routed-write recovery was only about 0.359.

causal_basis.novelty_boundary: This is not another strict-200x tensor topology sweep. It relaxes the state budget by 6-13x, fits both matrices jointly as functions, and assigns separate factors to every dense layer.

family.equation: W_l = sum_{r=1}^K A_{l,r} tensor-product B_{l,r}, independently for c_fc and c_proj
family.ordinary_rank_note: One full-rank Kronecker term can have ordinary matrix rank 768; K is Kronecker separation rank, not LoRA rank.
family.state_dependent_image_note: Both factors are learned state, so the Jacobian includes dA tensor B plus A tensor dB and is not a fixed BlockFHT image.

fit_protocol.initialization: deterministic rank-32 randomized Kronecker SVD of each exact dense teacher matrix; rank 16 uses the prefix
fit_protocol.fit_target: dense-teacher MLP outputs on teacher and compact state banks, including symmetric 1% RMS perturbations

report: fit objective and held-out output recovery
parameter, expansion-FLOP, memory, and wall-time accounting

frozen_gates.optimization_healthy: every layer/rank is finite and either reduces its fit objective by at least 50% or already passes the output gates before fitting
frozen_gates.rank16_pass: all function, CE, and health gates pass at 44.31x
frozen_gates.rank32_ceiling_pass: all function, CE, and health gates pass at 22.15x
frozen_gates.family_fail: rank 32 fails any function or CE gate despite healthy optimization

compute_accounting.factor_expansion_formula: 2 FLOPs per multiply-accumulate times K times 56,623,104 materialized weights
compute_accounting.generated_weight_memory: dense generated weights remain materialized for tensor-core GEMMs; the saving is trainable/optimizer state, not final dense inference storage

authorization.allowed: one preflight and one fixed-teacher paired-family ceiling at ranks 16 and 32
not_allowed: rank, radix, learning-rate, seed, or optimizer sweeps
claiming inference parameter compression before a non-materialized kernel exists
authorization.next_on_rank16_pass: implement the exact rank-16 training family, benchmark expansion and end-to-end MFU, then preregister one 124M 0.5TPP verification
authorization.next_on_rank32_only_pass: report the 22-44x state frontier and decide whether 22x is acceptable before implementation
authorization.next_on_failure: reject this paired Kronecker family at 22x and derive a different source of layer-private direction; do not sweep K
